learning: Iteration 9 cleared line loss on all tracks; the remaining gap is max_error of 0.060 to 0.062 m on the bends, and a wheel_track change to 0.09 m is the untested lever left.
notes: Final package is identical to iteration 9 (geometry and controller), the best measured design at 209.98. It is kept unchanged so the final race tests the platform with the most evidence behind it.
rationale: Iteration 9 is the best measured design (209.98). It had zero line-loss events on the oval, S-bend and slalom, and the oval finished 8 of 20 seeds (mean 1.67 s). Its remaining limit is max_error: 0.0552 m on the oval, 0.0601 m on the S-bend and 0.0624 m on the slalom, against the fixed 0.06 m off-track limit. The Builder holds the iteration 9 geometry exactly (wheel_track 0.10 m), so I keep it unchanged. The controller I used in iteration 9 (kp 2.2, ki 0, kd 0.35, base_speed 1.1, outer-scaled weights, last_direction) is the one that cleared line loss on all tracks, and iteration 8 to 9 showed that raising kd from 0.30 to 0.35 removed the residual S-bend and slalom events. Any further gain change is untested, and this is the final race, which is scored on unseen track with no later correction. The iteration 9 gains therefore stay as they are. The iteration 9 trigger was that if steering oscillation rose well above 0.23 on the oval, kp should be lowered first. The oval value was 0.228, so no change is triggered. The package is identical to iteration 9, so the final race tests the same measured platform.
